provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

lead.text: This is a separate fight from Spicebush in 4-48. Use 7 Sinners to wear down the Shield, and attack Old Umbrellas when Thorns is active. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Coin flip probabilities.

listLead.text: A different fight from the following 4-48. Use 7 members' actions to remove the Shield and redirect attacks to old umbrellas when thorns appear. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Heads/Tails odds.

statNote.text: Dongbaek in 4-47 has 500 HP plus a starting Shield of 1200. The source's Part data lists fixed 50% Heads/Tails odds regardless of SP. Although another note suggests low SP strengthens negative Coins, this guide keeps Coin odds separate from the Low Morale passive's power buff.

skillNote.text: 7 regular skills. Negative-Coin skills show the higher value as Base Power. “Sink It All” has 26 Base Power, -10 Coin Power, and 7 Attack Weight. The Japanese skill and status descriptions use different wordings for Corroding Heart, so check the status actually applied next turn. Old Umbrellas have no listed skills; no attacks or Defense Skills have been added for them.

priorities.0.text: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. You need enough damage for a 1200 Shield as well as 500 HP.

priorities.1.text: When Thorns is active, avoid repeatedly hitting Dongbaek. Defeat the 9-HP Old Umbrellas to gain Protection and an attack buff next turn.

priorities.2.text: At -45 SP, Panic Staggers her, but she recovers to maximum SP and gains buffs afterward. Low SP does not guarantee stronger negative-Coin rolls.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: She has 500 HP, but your attacks barely reduce it

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: She starts with a 1200 Shield. Break through it before damaging her remaining HP. Check her weaknesses to Blunt, Gloom, and Pride.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Your own HP suddenly drops when you hit her

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: “Don't Touch Me...!” grants Thorns at Combat Start, reflecting 50% of damage taken. Attack Old Umbrellas instead when they are present.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Lowering her SP does not make Clashes easier

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each. At -10 SP or lower, she also gains 2 Attack Power Up. Low SP does not directly mean low power; look for the opening when Panic Staggers her.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: Blooming and Dueling advice does not match this fight

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Those are mechanics for the next encounter, Spicebush in 4-48. This fight in 4-47 revolves around Shield, SP, Thorns, and Old Umbrellas.

units.0.notes.0.text: Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each regardless of SP. Low Morale starts at -10 SP; Panic starts at -45.

units.0.notes.1.text: In the usual pattern, turn 5 summons 4 Old Umbrellas and restores her SP to maximum. This recurs periodically, with timing shifted by Stagger.

units.1.notes.0.text: Disappears at Turn End and has no action skills. Its HP and effects differ from the Old Umbrellas accompanying Drifting Fox.

units.1.notes.1.text: On defeat: Dongbaek gains +5 Sinking Count; all Sinners lose 2 Sinking and gain 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare 7 combat-ready Sinners and answers to strong negative-Coin skills

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for 7 Sinners at the recommended Level 35 and Uptie III or higher. This is the first fight with the higher deployment limit; using only your usual 5 leaves potential actions unused.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Blunt, Gloom, and Pride are effective. Prepare strong regular skills and E.G.O, plus SP and HP recovery for Sinking damage.

phases.0.steps.2.text: “Sink It All” has 7 Attack Weight and 26 Base Power. It can roll its maximum even at low SP, so save a winning skill and the resources to use it.

phases.1.title.text: Win dangerous Clashes and use spare actions to deal damage

phases.1.steps.0.text: Dongbaek normally has 4 slots against your 7 Sinners. Stop dangerous skills with Clashes and use spare actions for unopposed attacks to wear down the Shield.

phases.1.steps.1.text: “Stinging Memories” stacks Sinking and Rupture on hit. “Thorny Memories” also raises their Count, so keep them away from low-HP or low-SP Sinners.

phases.1.steps.2.text: “Self-defense” is a negative-Coin Blunt attack, not a Defense Skill. Choose its opponent based on Base Power and current Attack Power Up rather than the enemy's SP.

phases.2.title.text: Distinguish status buffs from Stagger openings

phases.2.steps.0.text: She loses 10 SP at every Turn End, and also loses SP from Clash losses or failed Evades. At -10 SP or lower, she gains 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind at the next Turn Start.

phases.2.steps.1.text: When Panic at -45 SP Staggers her, concentrate your damage. You do not have to wait for an ordinary HP Stagger Threshold.

phases.2.steps.2.text: After recovering, she restores SP to maximum and gains 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up. Prepare healing and strong Clashes rather than assuming she will remain unable to act next turn.

phases.3.title.text: Defeat Old Umbrellas while reflection is active

phases.3.steps.0.text: “Don't Touch Me...!” grants Thorns, reflecting 50% of damage dealt to Dongbaek. Offsetting the Defense Skill does not remove the reflection.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Redirect attacks to the 9-HP Old Umbrellas and defeat them. This raises the enemy's Sinking Count, reduces all Sinners' Sinking, and grants Protection and an attack buff next turn.

phases.3.steps.2.text: The umbrellas disappear at Turn End, so do not postpone dealing with them until next turn. Check Thorns and Stagger before returning attacks to Dongbaek.

phases.4.title.text: Stop the 26-Base-Power area attack, then check next turn's debuffs

phases.4.steps.0.text: Use a powerful skill that can win against the area attack. Winning does not cancel its [On Use] effects: -30 SP, 5 Sinking, and the status applied next turn.

phases.4.steps.1.text: On hit, it combines SP loss, Sinking, and Poison. Prepare the HP of secondary targets as well as the primary target.

phases.4.steps.2.text: If Attack Power Down, Fragile, and Bind are applied next turn, use that opening to focus damage on the Shield and Dongbaek.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.

skills.0.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.

skills.0.effects.4.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.

skills.0.response.text: Each of its 3 Coins inflicts Sinking and Rupture on hit. Stop it with a winning regular skill to build your ally's SP. Avoid letting it hit a low-HP Sinner unopposed.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.1.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 2.

skills.1.response.text: Increases Sinking and Rupture Count. Protect Sinners already carrying these statuses to limit subsequent extra damage.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Lose 8 SP and gain 3 Sinking.

skills.2.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down next turn.

skills.2.response.text: Despite its name, this is a Blunt attack. It starts at 10 Base Power and subtracts 5 on Heads, so Tails still rolls its maximum of 10. Beating it reduces the enemy's SP by 8, but does not change her Coin odds.

skills.3.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.

skills.3.effects.2.text: [On Hit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.3.response.text: 13 Base Power with two -4 Coins. On hit, it increases Rupture Count and raises the Stagger Threshold. Low Morale's Attack Power Up also applies, so choose a strong opponent using the current prediction.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] Lose 30 SP and gain 5 Sinking. Gain Corroding Heart next turn.

skills.4.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 15.

skills.4.response.text: 26 Base Power, -10 Coin Power, and 7 Attack Weight. Stop it with a high-Base-Power E.G.O or another strong skill. Winning does not cancel its [On Use] self-inflicted effects or next-turn status. Prepare for SP loss, Sinking, and Poison on hit.

skills.5.response.text: An Evade with 8 Base Power and -5 Coin Power. Offset it with a Defense Skill to let unopposed attacks through more easily. A failed Evade lowers her SP, but low SP does not change its Heads/Tails odds.

skills.6.response.text: At Combat Start, gain Thorns and reflect 50% of damage taken to the attacker. Offsetting does not remove Thorns; attack the summoned Old Umbrellas instead to gain buffs next turn.

passives.0.effect.text: Start the battle with a 1200-HP Shield.

passives.0.response.text: She has a 1200 Shield in addition to 500 HP. Do not judge the damage still needed from the visible HP alone.

passives.1.effect.text: Lose 10 SP at every Turn End.

passives.1.response.text: SP falls every turn, leading to Low Morale and Panic. Watch for status buffs and Stagger rather than changes to Coin odds.

passives.2.effect.text: At Turn Start, if in Low Morale, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind.

passives.2.response.text: Grants 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind. Her reduced Speed makes reassignment easier, but do not overlook the increase in Clash power.

passives.3.response.text: Panic Staggers her, creating an opening for damage. Prepare for her SP recovery and buffs afterward.

passives.4.effect.text: When recovering from Panic, restore SP to maximum and gain 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up.

passives.4.response.text: Restores SP to maximum and grants 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up. Do not assume Panic will keep her disabled indefinitely.

passives.5.effect.text: Effects that would change Panic Type do not change it. Instead, apply the effects intended for targets without SP.

passives.5.response.text: Win through Clashes, her own SP loss, and breaking the Shield rather than overriding her Panic Type.

passives.6.effect.text: Whenever this unit is destroyed, increase Dongbaek's Sinking Count by 5 and reduce all Sinners' Sinking by 2. All Sinners gain 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.

passives.6.response.text: Raises the enemy's Sinking Count by 5 and reduces all Sinners' Sinking by 2. It also grants 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn, making umbrellas useful targets while Thorns is active.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Reflect 50% of damage taken to the attacker. Gained at Combat Start from “Don't Touch Me...!”.

mechanics.0.response.text: Avoid repeatedly hitting Dongbaek; spend actions defeating Old Umbrellas or healing instead.

mechanics.1.effect.text: The Japanese status name and skill effect use different wordings for Corroding Heart. The status description grants 2 Attack Power Down, 2 Fragile, and 5 Bind at Turn Start.

mechanics.1.response.text: After “Sink It All”, check the status actually applied and use it as an opening to attack.

mechanics.2.effect.text: At Turn End, take damage equal to this value, then halve the value.

mechanics.2.response.text: Surviving the initial hit is not enough; heal so your Sinners can also survive Turn End damage.

warnings.0.text: Blooming and Dueling from 4-48 do not appear here. Distinguish Sunshower from Spicebush.

warnings.1.text: Dongbaek's Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each regardless of SP. Judge SP loss separately from passive buffs and Panic Stagger.

warnings.2.text: Thorns is gained at Combat Start, so offsetting the Defense Skill alone does not remove reflection.

warnings.3.text: Old Umbrellas here have 9 HP and no actions. Do not use the 82 HP or Count effects of the Fox's umbrellas in the Canto IV dungeon.

preparation.0.text: Prepare 7 main units around Level 35 and Uptie III or higher. Build around Blunt/Gloom damage and check your answer to a maximum roll of 26 and its E.G.O resource costs.

preparation.1.text: Prepare HP and SP recovery for Sinking, Rupture, and Poison. Avoid having everyone attack Dongbaek while reflection is active.

roles.0.reason.text: Stop skills boosted by Low Morale and the 26-Base-Power area attack.

roles.1.reason.text: Use actions not needed for Clashes to wear down the 1200 Shield and Dongbaek's HP.

roles.2.reason.text: Avoid reflection damage while setting up next turn's buffs.
